title: Rad Bazaar Alert: Toyo-Built Rivendell Atlantis
content:
Our Rad Bazaar, the cycling world’s first member-supported buy/sell/trade forum, is full of magic these days, including this Toyo, Japan-built Rivendell Atlantis:

“Toyo made Atlantis. AT1077 stamped under BB. Much used and loved. Silver 2x crank (38×24) and Silver shifters. XTR rear derailleur. 9-speed. Shimano hubs and rims (700c) Rene Herse Barlow Pass 38s. Shimano DXR V-brakes. Ritchey post. Nitto Billie Bar. Nitto stem (110). Seat not included. See pics for condition. Happy to get you more pics if you’d like. I’d ship to you at your expense via BikeFlights.”

Check it out at the Rad Bazaar!

The post Rad Bazaar Alert: Toyo-Built Rivendell Atlantis appeared first on The Radavist.
author: John Watson
